podcast.body: This Gloria Gaynor album, released in 1975, was the first record to be produced in the "discomix" format. Its producer was directly influenced by the seamless track transitions found on *Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band*. "el primer disco grabado en formato discómics, que significa que las pistas están interconectadas sin huecos y que la música directamente está muy bien."

podcast.body: This entire album, released in 1975, featured disco tracks, including her hit rendition of "Never Can Say Goodbye" and a disco version of The Four Tops' "Reach Out I'll Be There." "Gainer's entire album Never Can Say Goodbye is made up of disco, including a kind of a disco file reach out I'll be there."
